tonight.headline: 43 up with Warren still to play
body: Bad news first, and three of this week's calls lost: Diggs' 20.3 sat on the bench while Wilson scored 15.6 in his slot; the Packers D/ST you claimed scored 4 against the Giants D/ST's 5; and Denzel Boston drew 2 targets on a bad toe, which falsifies the claim made for him. Green Bay and Cleveland are both on bye in Week 11.

None of it costs this game. Nicky Jam have Blake Corum under way and Zay Flowers on Monday night; ESPN projects 143.4 to 106.1 and gives you 99%. Warren plays tonight at Cincinnati, and nothing on your bench could take his RB slot even if he were a late scratch. Nothing to tap.

case.label: Their side
case.body: 84.36 banked. Corum (LAR, under way, 5.1) and Flowers (BAL, Monday) are what is left; Coker sits on their bench at 0.3.

case.label: The one late item
case.body: Pittsburgh's inactive list lands about 17:50 CDMX. Warren carries no designation (steelers.com 14 Nov). Etienne is your only bench back and has played, so a scratch would be a zero, not a decision.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing realistic: they need about 44 points from two players projected for 26.

whatWentWrong.title: Diggs outscored Wilson by 4.7
whatWentWrong.lead: Tuesday's swap put Wilson in on a 2.0 projection edge. Wilson drew 14 targets and scored 15.6; Diggs had 20.3.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Wilson 12.8 against Diggs 10.8, labelled PROJECTION by the lineup check. Diggs: 10 targets, 20.3 Thursday. Wilson: 14 targets, 15.6, while Geno Smith left twice and a rookie finished (archive; Yahoo/AP 15 Nov).

case.label: Why the policy stands
case.body: Diggs played Thursday, so the slot was set before Wilson's concussion was decided, and 2.0 is the edge of the coin-flip line. Nothing in the backtest beats the projection; one loss does not change that.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing about this slot — it is closed WRONG on the outcome. Week 11's question is who throws to Wilson: Smith's ankle, to be assessed before the Chargers (Yahoo/AP).

whatWentWrong.title: Boston's claim is falsified
whatWentWrong.lead: Two targets with Watson starting — the condition written when he was claimed. He played through the toe, and Cleveland's bye is next.

case.label: What happened
case.body: 1 catch on 2 targets for 16 yards; 'likely playing hurt' (NBC 21:37Z). Watson threw for 312 (Yahoo). The thesis said under 5 targets with Watson would prove it wrong.

case.label: What it means for Tuesday
case.body: He is your first drop candidate when a Week 11 need appears — Cleveland are on bye and the toe is not healed. Kamara, the player dropped for him, scored 16.4 today (archive).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A clean Browns practice report in Week 12's run-up and 7+ targets again — the role was real in Weeks 7-9 (7, 11, 8 targets, archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The D/ST stream lost by a point — and repeats Tuesday
whatWentWrong.lead: Packers D/ST 4, Giants D/ST 5. Green Bay are on bye in Week 11.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Cousins' first start back put 30 on Green Bay (Yahoo). The Giants D/ST you dropped scored 5 Thursday (archive).

case.label: Next
case.body: The slot needs a Week 11 defence. That is the Tuesday brief's decision, on Week 11 matchups this run did not research; Chem priority resets weekly.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing — the claim closes WRONG on the outcome. STRATEGY §5 holds: a stream needs a real gap, checked against the incumbent.
